verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a video API platform and its SDKs, but nothing in the evidence shows the platform or its client/server SDKs are published under an open license. The only open-source mention is a one-to-one sample app, which is not the product's own source and still requires an OpenTok account, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
